command: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== versions ==='; for p in /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad-cli /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad /Applications/KiCad/pcbnew.app/Contents/MacOS/pcbnew; do if test -x "$p"; then echo "--- $p"; "$p" --version 2>&1 || true; fi; done
